mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_ingest_task ( task_id, task_key, tenant_id, kb_id, document_id, version_id, document_version, generation, operation, stage, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_retry_at, lease_owner, lease_until, heartbeat_at, fencing_token, row_version, checkpoint, cancel_reason, cancel_requested_at, cancelled_at, error_code, error_message, trace_id, started_at, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{taskKey}, #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, #{versionId}, #{documentVersion}, #{generation}, #{operation}, #{stage}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseUntil}, #{heartbeatAt}, #{fencingToken}, #{rowVersion}, #{checkpoint}, #{cancelReason}, #{cancelRequestedAt}, #{cancelledAt}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{traceId}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rag_ingest_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM rag_ingest_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND kb_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM rag_ingest_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_key = #{taskKey} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM rag_ingest_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND document_id = #{documentId} AND status IN ('pending', 'running', 'retrying', 'cancel_requested') AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_document d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.kb_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rag_ingest_task t WHERE t.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND t.kb_id = d.kb_id AND t.document_id = d.document_id AND t.operation = 'delete' AND t.status = 'completed' AND t.deleted = 0 )

SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, task_id AS jobId FROM rag_ingest_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND ( (attempt_count < max_attempts AND ( status = 'pending' OR (status = 'retrying' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'running' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now}) )) OR (status = 'cancel_requested' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})) ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_ingest_task SET status = 'running', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, heartbeat_at = #{now}, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1, row_version = row_version + 1, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{now}), error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0 AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND ( status = 'pending' OR (status = 'retrying' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'running' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now}) )

UPDATE rag_ingest_task SET lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, heartbeat_at = #{now}, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'cancel_requested' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})

UPDATE rag_ingest_task SET stage = #{task.stage}, status = #{task.status}, attempt_count = #{task.attemptCount}, max_attempts = #{task.maxAttempts}, next_retry_at = #{task.nextRetryAt}, lease_owner = #{task.leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{task.leaseUntil}, heartbeat_at = CASE WHEN #{task.status} = 'running' AND #{task.leaseUntil} IS NOT NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END, fencing_token = #{task.fencingToken}, checkpoint = #{task.checkpoint}, cancel_reason = #{task.cancelReason}, cancel_requested_at = CASE WHEN #{task.status} = 'cancel_requested' THEN COALESCE(cancel_requested_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE cancel_requested_at END, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN #{task.status} = 'cancelled' THEN COALESCE(cancelled_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE cancelled_at END, error_code = #{task.errorCode}, error_message = #{task.errorMessage}, trace_id = COALESCE(#{task.traceId}, trace_id), started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{task.startedAt}), finished_at = CASE WHEN #{task.status} = 'pending' THEN NULL WHEN #{task.status} IN ('cancelled', 'completed', 'failed', 'dead') THEN COALESCE(finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE finished_at END, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{task.taskId} AND row_version = #{expectedRevision} AND deleted = 0
